description: This file defines the PersonName class, representing a person's name within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes various properties such as given name, family name, middle name, prefix, suffix, and associated methods for managing and formatting person names, along with annotations for persistence, indexing, and auditing.

classes.name: PersonName
classes.description: Represents a person's name with properties for various name components, annotations for persistence, indexing, and auditing, and utility methods for comparison and formatting within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: equalsContent
methods.description: Compares the inner content of this PersonName with another, ignoring null/empty fields on the compared name.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a PersonName object, copying all properties.

methods.name: getFamilyName
methods.description: Returns the family name, obscuring if configured.

methods.name: getGivenName
methods.description: Returns the given (first) name, obscuring if configured.

methods.name: getMiddleName
methods.description: Returns the middle name, obscuring if configured.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix (e.g., Mr., Mrs.), obscuring if configured.

methods.name: getFamilyNamePrefix
methods.description: Returns the family name prefix, obscuring if configured.

methods.name: getFamilyNameSuffix
methods.description: Returns the family name suffix, obscuring if configured.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Constructs and returns the full name using layout or concatenation of name parts.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Provides comparison logic for sorting PersonName objects, considering voided status, preferred status, and name components.
